items: Scheduled Cowork replies now wait for your review before anything changes. Switch that off per report under AI / Cowork if you'd rather they apply themselves.
Tachyread now starts in light or dark to match your device, until you pick a theme yourself.
Menus and dialogs use Atkinson Hyperlegible by default. Change it under Settings → Application → App font; your own reading fonts still win.
Streaks, finish dates and daily totals follow your own calendar: reading late in the evening counts for that day.
A bar tells you when a new version is ready, and another shows up if something goes wrong, with a Reload button.
About Tachyread (in Application settings) shows the version, where your data lives, storage used and diagnostics.
The camera and OCR engines now load from Tachyread's own site.
Delete everything says clearly that other apps and your Drive copy are left alone.
Queues can fill themselves from a description, suggest moving a book to a better queue (without asking twice), and prepare spoiler-free notes before you start.
Files you moved out of your search folders no longer show their old location.
Add a whole folder of books to Trackyread without opening them.
Listen mode plays straight through a reading queue, with chapter and book skips on the lock screen.
Narration clips are stored 15 to 30 times smaller.
Reading aloud gives a presenting score from your camera.
